Footer.DisclaimerText: Book your appointment online and pay securely through our payment gateway, or pay at the hospital on arrival. Please arrive 15 minutes before your appointment with a valid photo ID. Timings may occasionally change due to doctor availability or emergencies; the hospital will inform you if this happens. For changes or cancellations, please contact the hospital.
